prompt: Who did the Canadian swimmer Eric Lamont compete against in Heat 3 of the freestyle competition that he was older than?
answer: Eric Lamont (then Eric Jubb) competed against **Jean Boiteux of France** in Heat 3. Lamont was older: he was born **17 January 1931**, while Boiteux was born **20 June 1933**.
